newsitem.title: CANADA: Placer unsure of Bre-X bid amount.
newsitem.headline: Placer unsure of Bre-X bid amount.

text.p: Placer Dome Inc will not decide precisely how many shares it will offer for each Bre-X Minerals Ltd common share until after it negotiates with Bre-X, a Placer spokesman said on Tuesday.
"We don't know the details on any structure to that level of detail because we want to sit down and talk with Bre-X," spokesman Hugh Leggatt said in a telephone interview.

Placer said earlier it offered Bre-X a stock-for-stock "merger of equals" at a "significant" premium to Bre-X's current share price under which all of Bre-X's shares would be exchanged for a fixed number of Placer shares.
